description: This file defines a widget for an Android application that displays the 'Word of the Day' from Wiktionary. It includes a WidgetProvider class and an inner Service class that fetches data from the API, processes the content using regex, and updates the widget view accordingly.

classes.name: WordWidget
classes.description: An AppWidgetProvider responsible for updating and managing the Word of the Day widget on the Android home screen.

methods.name: onUpdate
methods.description: Starts the background service to fetch and update the widget when an update is triggered.

classes.name: UpdateService
classes.description: Background service that fetches the 'Word of the Day' from Wiktionary, processes the content, and updates the widget views.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Builds the widget update and pushes it to the home screen.

methods.name: buildUpdate
methods.description: Performs API call, regex parsing, and constructs the RemoteViews to display.

methods.name: onBind
methods.description: Required method for Service, returns null as binding is not used.
